title: A positive solution to Tingley’s problem
summary: Every surjective isometry between the unit spheres of real Banach spaces extends uniquely to a surjective real-linear isometry, giving an affirmative solution to Tingley's problem. If distances between different radii are not preserved, we realize the positive maximal defect in a possibly enlarged pair of Banach spaces. We then align extremal chords using common supports and Darbo's fixed-point theorem and obtain a contradiction from support and convexity estimates.

review.reason: Solves Tingley's problem on extending surjective isometries between unit spheres of Banach spaces.
